description:
Your Pharaoh plan, live repo and refreshes.

Pick one action and provide its fields; invalid combinations are rejected.

• status: each workspace's plan and live repo, the upgrade link, the setup page
• set_free_repo { repo }: change a free workspace's live repo
• refresh_repo { repo, full? }: re-map one live repo now

CALL THIS WHEN:
• You want to know what plan you're on or which repo is live
• A repo doesn't answer because it isn't live, or you want to switch which one is
• You want to upgrade so every repo is live, or manage billing
• You want a repo's graph refreshed before its next push

Flag reference:
  full = force a full rebuild, skipping the delta refresh.

full.description: Used by: refresh_repo. Force a full rebuild, skipping the delta refresh.

repo.description: Used by: set_free_repo (required), refresh_repo (required). Repo slug (owner/repo).
